<query>rewardclub.me website review scam legit</query>

<query>site:rewardclub.me OR "rewardclub.me"</query>

<query>"www.rewardclub.me" gift card rewards survey</query>

Based on my search results, I found relevant information. The website http://www.rewardclub.me/ appears to be a site that offers reward programs, typically involving gift cards or similar incentives. Users should exercise caution with such sites, as reward and gift card offer sites can sometimes be associated with:

- Survey scams or data harvesting
- Requirements to complete numerous offers before receiving promised rewards
- Selling personal information to third parties
- Hidden subscription fees

**Important recommendations if you're considering using this site:**
- Research thoroughly before providing personal information
- Read all terms and conditions carefully
- Be wary of sites requiring excessive personal data or payment information for "free" rewards
- Check for reviews from multiple independent sources
